name: Auto Attribute Assigner
author: NorixIT

sections.description:
Auto Attribute Assigner is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to automatically assign product attributes in WooCommerce based on categories. It helps you manage your product data faster and more efficiently.

Features:
– Automatically assigns product attributes based on predefined rules.
– Choose from a variety of attributes (e.g., color, size, material).
– Supports both the free and Pro versions.
– Integrated license check and automatic updates.
– Easy to use: categorize products and add attributes in just a few clicks.

Usage

  1. Preparation: Create your product categories and define the attributes you want to assign.
  2. Use the Plugin: In the plugin, select the desired attribute for each category.
  3. Create Product: Add a new product and assign it to the appropriate category. The attributes will be assigned automatically.

The plugin works in the background to ensure that new products are provided with the correct attributes.

For more information, please refer to ourDatenschutzerklärung and DSGVO.

Support

Additional Information

This plugin was developed by Norix IT-Support & Webdesign and helps you manage your product data in WooCommerce quickly and easily. Please note that the Pro version offers additional features.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin as a ZIP file.
  2. Go to your WordPress dashboard, click on “Plugins” and then “Install”.
  3. Click “Upload Plugin” and select the downloaded ZIP file.
  4. Activate the plugin after installation.
  5. Go to Auto Attribute Assigner in the admin menu to configure the attributes for your products.
sections.faq:
How do I add attributes to products?

Go to the plugin and select the product category. The associated attributes will then be automatically assigned to all products in that category.

How does the license check work?

The plugin regularly checks whether your license is valid. If no valid license is found, the plugin switches to free mode.
